summary:
OMNEXIS is a web-based project designed to help monitor astronauts' health during space missions. Space can have a serious impact on the human body, so keeping track of health indicators is very important.
Our platform provides tools for checking heart rate, body temperature, blood pressure, blood analysis, and diabetes-related indicators. It also includes an interactive 3D astronaut model that allows users to select different parts of the body and access health assessment tools.
All recorded results are displayed on a dashboard, where users can review health information and medical events in one place.
The current version is a prototype. Health data is entered manually or simulated for demonstration because the platform is not yet connected to real medical sensors. It does not provide medical diagnoses.
During development, our team used Claude AI to assist with programming, debugging, and design improvements. The project idea, planning, and development decisions were guided by our team.
Our goal is to make astronaut health information easier to monitor, understand, and manage during space exploration.
OMNEXIS — A smarter approach to astronaut health monitoring.
